title: Applied ML Engineer
description:
**Role Overview** 




  






 We are looking for an Applied Machine Learning Engineer to help build the model development, experimentation, evaluation, and deployment machinery for a new generation of proprietary analytical systems.
 




  






 This role sits at the intersection of applied machine learning, data engineering, mathematical modeling, and production software. You will work directly with technical leadership to translate proprietary mathematical and theoretical structures into practical ML workflows, model experiments, validation systems, and production\-ready inference tools.
 




  






 We need someone who can build production\-ready systems: feature pipelines, training workflows, evaluation harnesses, model comparison tools, inference services, and monitoring processes.
 





 We are moving fast. Multiple major initiatives have aggressive timelines, so we need someone who can contribute immediately and maintain a strong pace.
 




  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Build applied ML pipelines for proprietary data, analytical features, and model targets.
* Work with technical leadership to translate mathematical concepts into computational representations.
* Design and implement feature engineering workflows, training datasets, model evaluation tools, and experiment tracking.
* Develop validation frameworks that prevent data leakage, overfitting, look\-ahead bias, and misleading performance claims.
* Train, compare, and evaluate multiple model families based on the structure of the problem.
* Build reproducible model training and inference workflows.
* Package successful models into production\-ready services, batch jobs, or internal tools.
* Collaborate with Python/data engineers to integrate ML workflows into larger data systems.
* Create model documentation, assumptions, limitations, and performance summaries.
* Help establish best practices for model versioning, monitoring, retraining, drift detection, and reproducibility.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




  




* Strong professional experience with Python and applied machine learning.
* Strong understanding of scikit\-learn, pandas, NumPy, and modern ML workflows.
* Experience building end\-to\-end ML pipelines from raw data through evaluation and deployment.
* Strong understanding of train/test splitting, validation design, leakage prevention, and model evaluation.
* Experience with time\-series, sequential, financial, operational, scientific, logistics, or similarly structured data.
* Ability to work with ambiguous, proprietary, or non\-standard problem definitions.
* Ability to think from first principles and build systems appropriate to the problem.
* Strong software engineering habits: modular code, testing, documentation, reproducibility, and clean interfaces.
* Comfort working closely with domain experts and translating mathematical intent into implementation.
* Clear communication about model behavior, limitations, risks, and tradeoffs.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience with PyTorch, XGBoost, LightGBM, statsmodels, MLflow, Databricks ML, or similar tooling.
* Experience with forecasting, classification, ranking, anomaly detection, representation learning, or sequence modeling.
* Experience with model deployment, batch inference, APIs, or production ML systems.
* Experience designing backtests, simulation frameworks, or historical validation systems.
* Familiarity with feature stores, model registries, experiment tracking, and monitoring.
* Experience working with proprietary algorithms, quantitative systems, or mathematically complex domains.
* Familiarity with Spark, Databricks, SQL, parquet, Delta tables, or large\-scale analytical workflows.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




  






 Within the first 30 days, you understand the available data, help define initial modeling targets, build early feature and evaluation pipelines, and begin running controlled experiments.
 




  






 Within 60 days, you have helped establish a repeatable ML workflow that can ingest proprietary features, train candidate models, evaluate performance reliably, and support production deployment decisions.
 




  





**Ideal Candidate** 




  






 You ask what the system is actually trying to infer, what information is available at prediction time, how labels are constructed, where leakage might occur, and what failure would look like in production.
 




  






 You are practical, mathematically literate, implementation\-oriented, and comfortable building ML systems around proprietary domain logic that may not fit standard textbook examples.

**Help us decarbonize cement and concrete \- not tomorrow, today.**
 alcemy is on a mission to keep 100 million tons of CO₂ out of the atmosphere every year by 2030\. description:
**Deine Aufgaben**
**Über Perelyn**
 Perelyn ist eine KI\-Beratung, die bedeutungsvolle Innovation mit KI ermöglicht. Wir verbinden tiefe wissenschaftliche Expertise mit unternehmerischem Verständnis: Research at heart, Business in mind.
   

  

 Unser Team von mehr als 20 KI\-Experten hat über 200 KI\-Projekte umgesetzt und mehr als 75 wissenschaftliche Publikationen beigetragen. Wir arbeiten mit führenden Organisationen verschiedenster Branchen zusammen, von der Strategie bis zur produktionsreifen Umsetzung. Unser Team vereint promovierte Wissenschaftlerinnen und Wissenschaftler mit erfahrenen Führungskräften aus Unternehmen wie Amazon, SAP, Munich Re und von der Stanford University. Wir sind überzeugt: Vielfältige Teams entwickeln kreativere, durchdachtere Lösungen und erzielen bessere Ergebnisse.
   

  

 Mit Hauptsitz in München und europäischer Präsenz gestalten wir die Zukunft der KI\-Beratung.
   

  

**Die Rolle**
 Als Principal Consultant AI Solutions machst Du aus KI\-Potenzial echten Geschäftsnutzen. Du erkennst Möglichkeiten, baust die Lösung und trägst die Verantwortung dafür, dass sie geliefert wird.
   

  

 Du verantwortest komplexe KI\-Engagements von Anfang bis Ende: die Identifikation des richtigen Anwendungsfalls, die Entwicklung des Business Case gemeinsam mit unserer AI Strategy \& Value Practice, die Gestaltung der Lösungsarchitektur und die Steuerung eines Teams bis zum Ergebnis, auf das der Kunde zählen kann.
   

  

 Du fühlst dich gleichermaßen wohl, wenn Du im Vorstandsgespräch die Richtung vorgibst, wie wenn Du bei einem engen Termin oder einem turbulenten Projektverlauf selbst mit anpackst. Du hast anspruchsvolle Arbeiten unter Druck und Unsicherheit wiederholt erfolgreich abgeschlossen und misst Erfolg an den Ergebnissen Deiner Kunden, nicht an den Deliverables, die Du übergibst.
   

  

 Intern spielst Du eine Schlüsselrolle bei unserer KI\-nativen Transformation: Du prägst, wie wir KI in unserer eigenen Praxis einsetzen, und setzt den Standard für das Team.
   

  

**Deine Aufgaben**
*Client Engagement \& Delivery*
* Du verantwortest die Umsetzung komplexer KI\-Projekte vom Proof\-of\-Concept bis zum Produktiveinsatz und hältst Scope, Qualität und Zeitpläne auch unter Druck im Griff.
* Du leitest KI\-Strategie\-Workshops und Assessments mit Entscheidungsträgerinnen und Entscheidungsträgern auf C\-Level, um wirkungsstarke KI\-Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren.
* Du führst Projektteams zu erfolgreichen Ergebnissen, triffst die Entscheidungen, die die Delivery am Laufen halten, und stärkst das Vertrauen des Kunden.
* Du entwirfst und konzipierst KI\-Lösungen über das gesamte Spektrum: etwa Generative AI, klassisches Machine Learning, Computer Vision sowie MLOps und LLMOps.
* Du begleitest Build\-vs.\-Buy\-Entscheidungen und evaluierst Modelle, Technologie\-Stacks und Infrastrukturoptionen für Enterprise\-Kunden.
* Du agierst als zentraler Ansprechpunkt für den Kunden: Du antizipierst Bedürfnisse, erkennst, wo weitere KI\-Initiativen Wert schaffen können, und entwickelst aus zufriedenen Kunden langfristige Partner.
* Du gestaltest neue Projektangebote mit und treibst Discovery\- und Scoping\-Gespräche mit potenziellen und bestehenden Kunden aktiv voran, und hilfst dabei, deren Bedürfnisse in klar definierte, umsetzbare Engagements zu übersetzen.


*Thought Leadership \& interne Wirkung*
* Du treibst Perelyns KI\-native Transformation voran, indem Du den Einsatz von KI\-Tools, Workflows und Methoden innerhalb unserer eigenen Praxis wegweisend gestaltest.
* Du trägst zum Wissensaufbau bei, etwa durch Publikationen, Konferenzbeiträge, Workshops oder kundenorientierte Thought Leadership.
* Du mentorst und entwickelst Consultants und förderst eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens und hoher Ansprüche.
* Du gestaltest Serviceangebote und Methoden auf Basis aktueller KI\-Trends weiter, einschließlich KI\-Compliance und \-Sicherheit.


**Dein Profil**
**Must\-Have**
* Technischer Hintergrund in AI/ML mit Praxiserfahrung: Du hast Modelle in einem professionellen Umfeld aufgebaut, trainiert oder deployed, zum Beispiel als ML Engineer, Data Scientist oder AI Researcher.
* Eine nachweisliche Erfolgsbilanz bei der Umsetzung mehrerer bedeutender Projekte von Anfang bis Ende, auch unter engen Deadlines und sich verändernden Anforderungen, mit voller Verantwortung für das Ergebnis.
* Mehr als 8 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon ein relevanter Teil in kundenseitigen oder cross\-funktionalen Rollen.
* Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Projektteams erfolgreich zu führen: Du steuerst erfahrene Experten und entwickelst Junior Consultants gleichermaßen, durch echte technische Tiefe, Entschlossenheit und Urteilsvermögen in unklaren Situationen.
* Echte Kundenorientierung: Du gewinnst schnell Vertrauen und stellst das Ergebnis für den Kunden in den Mittelpunkt jeder Entscheidung.
* Die Fähigkeit, souverän zwischen verschiedenen Zielgruppen zu wechseln: klar und glaubwürdig sowohl im Gespräch mit Führungskräften als auch mit Ingenieuren und Wissenschaftlern.
* Fundiertes Verständnis der KI\-Landschaft: LLMs, Generative AI, MLOps/LLMOps und aktuelle Best Practices für KI im Enterprise\-Umfeld.
* Fließende Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Promotion oder Master\-Abschluss in Informatik, AI/ML, Mathematik, Physik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.
* Erfahrung in der Beratung, bei einer Managementberatung, einem Technologieunternehmen oder einer spezialisierten KI\-Boutique.
* Expertise in KI\-Compliance, Trustworthy AI oder KI\-Sicherheit.
* Branchenkenntnis in einem oder mehreren Sektoren, etwa Energie, Fertigung, Finanzdienstleistungen oder Handel.
* Ein bestehendes professionelles Netzwerk im DACH\-KI\-Ökosystem.
* Publikationen oder öffentliche Vorträge zu KI\-Themen.


**Warum wir?**
* Du arbeitest an der Spitze der KI\-Beratung, gemeinsam mit einem Team, das wissenschaftliche Sorgfalt und unternehmerische Wirkung vereint.
* Du gestaltest das Wachstum einer dynamischen europäischen KI\-Beratung aktiv mit. Deine Ideen und deine Initiative haben direkten Einfluss auf unsere Richtung.
* Du arbeitest mit promovierten Wissenschaftlerinnen und Wissenschaftlern, erfahrenen Führungskräften aus der Industrie und einem wirklich diversen, internationalen Team zusammen.
* Eine Kultur, die auf Eigenverantwortung, dem Streben nach Wahrheit und kontinuierlichem Lernen aufbaut. Keine Bürokratie.
* Flexibilität und Autonomie: Münchner Büro plus Remote\-Arbeit in ganz Deutschland, mit dem Vertrauen, deine Zeit selbst einzuteilen.
* Echte Einblicke in zukunftsweisende Projekte in den Bereichen Generative AI, Computer Vision, AI Operations und Compliance.
* Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit leistungsbasiertem Bonus und jährlicher Gehaltsüberprüfung.
* Möglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung deiner (technischen) Expertise, mit Übernahme relevanter Weiterbildungs\- und Zertifizierungskosten.


**Über uns**
 Wir bei Perelyn sind ein führendes Beratungsunternehmen im Bereich der künstlichen Intelligenz und entwickeln innovative und nachhaltige Lösungen für unsere Kunden und Partner. Von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung decken wir das gesamte Spektrum von KI\-Produkten, Dienstleistungen und Strategien ab. Im Laufe der Jahre haben wir Unternehmen wie MunichRe, ProSiebenSat.1, T\-Systems, Deutsche Bank und Zeiss Semiconductor bei ihrer digitalen Transformation begleitet. Darüber hinaus entwickeln wir eigene Produkte und Dienstleistungen und fördern einen unternehmerischen Geist.
   

  

 Bei Perelyn bringen wir die richtigen Menschen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und Fähigkeiten zusammen und investieren kontinuierlich in die Entwicklung unserer Mitarbeiter, indem wir ihr Engagement im Einklang mit ihren persönlichen Zielen fördern.
   

  

 Auch wenn du nicht alle in der Stellenbeschreibung aufgeführten Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten erfüllst, ermutigen wir dich zur Bewerbung, wenn dich die Rolle und unsere Mission begeistern.

title: Senior Applied Scientist for Tabular ML (f/m/d)
description:
**We help the world run better**
 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

**What you\`ll do:**
 You’ll work at the intersection of advanced AI research, enterprise applications, and real\-world problem solving, partnering closely with internal teams and model researchers to evaluate and improve high\-value use cases.
   

  

 In this applied, hands\-on role, you’ll analyze challenging use cases across the organization, understand their business context, and help push our tabular foundation models to their full potential. Through debugging, benchmarking, and deep technical iteration, you’ll uncover patterns, limitations, and opportunities, and turn them into actionable insights that directly inform model research and model architecture improvements.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate deeply with application teams and domain experts, serving as a bridge between practical use\-case execution and ongoing model research. Your input will have a direct impact on how our models evolve and how effectively they perform on meaningful enterprise problems.
   

  

**The Role**
* Partner with internal teams and model researchers to evaluate high\-value use cases and understand their business context.
* Analyze use cases across the organization and advise on how to make them work effectively with our tabular foundation models.
* Work hands\-on with cutting\-edge tabular foundation models to debug and benchmark model behavior, pushing performance on meaningful enterprise problems.
* Distill patterns, limitations, and opportunities from applied work into actionable insights, including suggestions for improvements to model architecture.


**What You Bring**
* PhD or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or other relevant disciplines with 5\+ years of professional experience in developing machine learning models.
* Extensive hands\-on experience developing predictive use cases on tabular data in a data scientist role, ideally with S/4HANA data.
* Deep master of deep learning and Transformer architectures, including application to structured enterprise data, along with strong software engineering skills in Python and a proven track record of building and scaling experiments with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross\-cultural teams.

 SAP is uniquely positioned to lead the next wave of AI by infusing intelligence directly into the business processes that run the world. Our team’s mission is to develop Foundation Models for structured data, starting with the launch and continued evolution of SAP\-RPT\-1\. As the first generation of our relational model portfolio, SAP\-RPT\-1 represents our commitment to pioneering new research in a domain where SAP’s expertise in enterprise data structures provides an unmatched competitive edge. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end\-to\-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management.  SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well\-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. description:

* Du bereitest komplexe Daten auf, modellierst, analysierst und visualisierst sie. * In teamorientierten, interdisziplinären und agilen Projekten auf Augenhöhe bringst Du Dich und deine Expertise ein.
* Du konzipierst und entwickelst Lösungen auf modernen Plattformen und Cloud\-Umgebungen wie z.B. Azure oder AWS.
* Durch einen abwechslungsreichen und herausfordernden Arbeitsalltag sowie vielseitige Schulungen für Methodik, Fachwissen und technische Fähigkeiten kannst Du eine steile Lernkurve erleben.
* Zudem bringst Du Deine Interessen und kreativen Ideen in Initiativen und in Zusammenarbeit mit Kooperationspartner\*innen ein, um aktuelle Trends am Markt mitzugestalten.


**Dein Profil**
* Du hast einen Studienabschluss in Informatik, (Wirtschafts\-)Mathematik, Physik, Data Science oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
* Außerdem hast Du erste berufliche Erfahrungen, idealerweise in der Unternehmensberatung oder der IT.
* Du verfügst über Methodenwissen in Statistik, Machine Learning und IT\-Infrastrukturen sowie erste Erfahrungen in der Anwendung von Machine Learning Modellen.
* Du hast sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python, gerne flankiert durch Erfahrung im Bereich Datenbanken wie SQL/postgreSQL.
* An der kooperativen Arbeit in agilen Projektteams hast Du Interesse.
* An komplexen Aufgaben und dem Umgang mit Daten hast Du Freude.
* Du bist reisebereit und flexibel.
* Du verfügst über Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch auf C1\-Level und Englisch auf B2\-Level.
* Idealerweise hast Du darüber hinaus Grundkenntnisse in der API\-Entwicklung, einen sicheren Umgang mit Versionsverwaltung via git und Grundkenntnisse in LaTeX.


**Deine Benefits**
* **Willkommen im Team** 
 Damit Du von Beginn an voll bei uns durchstarten kannst, begleiten wir Dich mit strukturierten Onboarding\-Maßnahmen während der gesamten Orientierungsphase. Zudem fördert Deine Führungskraft gezielt Deine fachliche und persönliche Integration ins Team.

 Wir legen Wert auf die individuelle Entwicklung Deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Stärken: Deine eigenen Ambitionen reflektieren wir in strukturierten Entwicklungsgesprächen. Systematische und regelmäßige Feedback\-Gespräche unterstützen Dich beim Erreichen dieser Ziele. Ab dem Level Manager und Managerin kannst Du auch Personal\- und Führungsverantwortung übernehmen. Deine Führungskompetenz fördern wir mit individuellem Coaching und spezifischen Führungstrainings. Als Teil des weltweiten KPMG\-.Netzwerks bieten wir Dir zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten im In\- und Ausland und somit wertvolle Einblicke in die Vielfalt unserer Tätigkeitsbereiche.
* **Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben** 
 Wir sind überzeugt, dass es vor allem Vielfalt und Flexibilität braucht, um Innovationen zu fördern und langfristige Erfolge zu sichern. Nur so können wir die besten Ideen entwickeln und wirklich innovative Lösungen finden. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice\-Option, Zeitkonten und Auszeiten schaffen wir Räume, um Privat\- und Berufsleben miteinander zu vereinbaren.
* **Fort\- \& Weiterbildung** 
 Durch regelmäßige Trainings, Workshops und Weiterbildungen entwickelst Du Deine Fähigkeiten stetig weiter. Zudem fördern wir Berufsexamina sowie berufsbegleitende Master\-Studiengänge. **Responsibility, E.g. Budget, Key Deliverables**

title: Data Scientist
description:
We are seeking a driven and creative Data Scientist with a minimum of 3 years of experience in a data science or machine learning role, who will be instrumental in building predictive models, testing hypotheses, and providing statistically sound insights that enhance our lead generation capabilities. The Data Scientist will be part of our analytics team, working closely with IT, marketing, media buying and CRO teams to transform raw data into actionable insights, whether that means building real\-time scoring models, investigating campaign performance, or helping the business distinguish signal from noise when making decisions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is someone who thrives on solving ambiguous problems, brings strong statistical intuition alongside machine learning skills, and can serve as a trusted analytical partner to stakeholders across the business. They're as comfortable building production ML pipelines as they are answering a media buyer's question about whether a source is actually underperforming or just experiencing variance. Experience in digital marketing, lead generation, or ad\-tech is highly desirable.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Leverage agentic AI\-assisted development tools throughout the workflow, from exploratory analysis and feature engineering to model development and pipeline building, to accelerate iteration speed while maintaining rigor and code quality
* Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models to segment and score landing page visitors based on intent and lead quality, using behavioral signals such as scroll depth, click patterns, session duration, and form engagement.
* Engineer predictive features from raw user behavior data to improve model accuracy and business relevance.
* Build and maintain real\-time scoring pipelines that enable dynamic postback signals to ad networks, improving campaign optimization speed and efficiency.
* Collaborate with marketing and analytics teams to define quality/intent tiers and translate business logic into quantifiable model outputs.
* Conduct exploratory data analysis and experimentation to uncover patterns in user behavior that correlate with downstream lead quality and conversion outcomes.
* Continuously monitor, evaluate, and iterate on model performance, ensuring alignment with evolving business goals and traffic patterns.
* Contribute to forecasting and budget projection initiatives as needed, supporting strategic planning with data\-driven modeling.
* Clearly communicate, document and present findings, methodologies, and model specifications for cross\-functional, non\-technical stakeholders.
* Support data\-driven decision\-making by quantifying uncertainty, assessing statistical significance, and challenging assumptions when the data doesn't support them.
* Identify and quantify relationships between behavioral signals, traffic sources, campaign attributes, and lead quality outcomes; distinguish meaningful correlations from spurious ones.
* Serve as an analytical partner to media buyers and marketing teams: investigate campaign and source performance, validate hypotheses about lead quality, and provide statistically rigorous answers to business questions.


 Requirements:
   

  

* 3\+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or a related quantitative role.
* Comfortable working in agentic AI\-assisted development environments (e.g., Cursor, ClaudeCode, Antigravity) to accelerate model development, data exploration, and pipeline building, including the judgment to know when AI\-generated outputs need manual verification or refinement.
* Strong proficiency in Python, including ML libraries such as scikit\-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, or similar.
* Solid experience with feature engineering, particularly from behavioral, clickstream, or event\-based data.
* Familiarity with deploying models in production environments; experience with real\-time or near\-real\-time inference is a strong plus.
* Strong foundation in statistical inference, hypothesis testing and root\-cause analysis: can distinguish signal from noise, assess significance, and communicate uncertainty clearly.
* Proficiency in SQL and experience working with large\-scale datasets.
* Understanding of classification, regression, and clustering techniques; experience with user segmentation or propensity modeling preferred.
* Exposure to digital marketing concepts and KPIs (CPL, CVR, ROAS, etc.) is highly desirable.
* Ability to translate vague business questions into testable hypotheses and structured analyses.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to work through ambiguity and define structure where none exists.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Team\-oriented mindset with a collaborative and proactive approach.
* Upper\-Intermediate or higher level of English.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience building or using custom skills, prompt workflows, or tool\-use patterns within agentic coding environments.
* Experience in lead generation, ad\-tech, or performance marketing environments.
* Familiarity with ad network optimization, postback mechanisms, or conversion APIs.
* Experience with cloud platforms and MLOps tools.
* Background in time\-series forecasting or demand modeling.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**About the role** 




 We're seeking a EU\-based Product Designer with a growth focus to help more people access the right support for their ADHD. You'll combine solid design instincts with data\-driven optimization to scale our impact.
 



  





 Inflow was recently acquired by Cerebral, one of the largest digital mental health providers in the US. This opens up a broader range of support we can offer our users, from self\-guided learning in the Inflow app to professional therapy via Cerebral, or a combination of both.
 



  





 A big part of this role is designing the experience that helps users find the right path for them.
 



 You'll work closely with Product and Engineering to run experiments and ship improvements across the full user journey, from how users discover and choose the right support, through to activation and long\-term engagement.
 



  





 This role is hands\-on and AI\-native. You'll use modern AI tools to go from idea to working prototype fast and sometimes what you build will be close enough to ship. We're looking for someone who sees AI as a force multiplier for design velocity. 
 



  





 You'll own the design process end\-to\-end: discovery, ideation, solution design, high\-fidelity execution, and iteration.
 



  





 Balancing fast experimentation with thoughtful solutions, you'll work across the full spectrum of growth — from how users discover us, to how they convert, engage, and stay. We're a small team so you'll have real ownership and direct impact. 
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Own end\-to\-end design across growth surfaces — from research and ideation through high\-fidelity implementation and continuous optimization
* Design and optimize key growth surfaces. Funnels, onboarding, engagement, retention, referrals and more, across web and app
* Go from idea to working prototype fast using AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) — sometimes close enough to ship
* Develop and validate design hypotheses through A/B testing and quantitative data
* Conduct user research to inform design decisions and uncover opportunities
* Balance rapid experimentation with thoughtful solutions, knowing when to iterate quickly vs. invest in deeper exploration



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 3\+ years of B2C product design experience — consumer apps, e\-commerce, or subscription products, with proven impact on business metrics.
* You're particularly strong in at least one area that matters to us, whether that's conversion design, building with AI, compelling UX storytelling, or running experiments that move metrics
* Growth experience with hands\-on work in at least two areas: CRO, onboarding, activation, monetization, retention, referrals, checkout, or AOV optimisation
* Already building with AI (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) as a natural part of your design workflow
* Comfortable with A/B testing and data\-informed design decisions — you don't need to be a data scientist, but you need to understand that experiments drive priorities in this role
* Strong portfolio demonstrating design process and measurable outcomes
* Good design instincts around user psychology and behavior
* Comfortable with ambiguity, fast pace, and working in a small team with real ownership



  





**Nice\-to\-haves** 



* Background in mental health or healthcare products

title: SENIOR DATA SCIENTIST
description:
En Mango vestimos de pasión todo lo que hacemos. Con origen en Barcelona y presencia en más de 120 países, inspiramos al mundo con creatividad, innovación y autenticidad.
   

  

 Nuestro equipo multicultural es el motor de nuestro éxito. Nos enorgullece llevar la moda más allá, conectando nuestro estilo único con personas de todo el mundo.
   

  

 Estamos buscando un/a Senior Data Scientist para unirse a nuestro equipo de Data\&Advanced Analytics.
   

  

 Formarás parte del equipo que da forma a la inteligencia, estrategia y arquitectura de datos de Mango. El equipo de Advanced Analytics desarrolla algoritmos de Inteligencia Artificial dirigidos a optimizar los procesos y decisiones más desafiantes dentro de la industria del retail.
   

  

 El equipo de Advanced Analytics de Mango está formado por Data Scientists, Big Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Deep Learning Researchers y Software Engineers que trabajan juntos en squads multidisciplinares para desarrollar algoritmos de aprendizaje automático de calidad de vanguardia aprovechando la última tecnología en plataformas de Big Data y computación distribuida.
   

  

 Cada Uno De Los Squads De Análisis Avanzado Tiene Como Objetivo Desarrollar y Evolucionar Algoritmos Para Hacer Frente a Algunos De Los Principales Retos Técnicos y Empresariales De Mango
   

  

* Personalization Squad: Equipo al que se incorporará la persona seleccionada y que es responsable de desarrollar algoritmos de Inteligencia Artificial para proporcionar una experiencia personalizada a los clientes de Mango, tanto en el sitio web y la app como en las comunicaciones por email. Aprovechando el gran volumen de datos de compras y de navegación de los clientes, los algoritmos desarrollados incluyen recomendaciones de productos, segmentaciones de clientes, un asistente conversacional de IA que actúa como asesor de moda para nuestros clientes o la generación de contenido personalizado mediante IA generativa, asegurando su despliegue en tiempo real.
* Generative Artificial Intelligence squad: Impulsar iniciativas innovadoras relacionadas con algoritmos generativos (texto, imagen, video, etc). Este squad ha liderado el desarrollo de la plataforma de IA basada en LLM para los casos de uso internos. Además, es responsable de impulsar la transformación que se está llevando a cabo en los procesos creativos empleando modelos de IA de generación de imágenes.
* Pricing and Mark\-Down Squad: Desarrollar algoritmos de aprendizaje automático que determinen las promociones y descuentos óptimos para optimizar el margen de la empresa durante el periodo de ventas.
* Purchasing/Production Squad: Desarrollar algoritmos de ciencia de datos para la detección temprana de best\-sellers y para determinar cuántas unidades de cada producto y talla debe fabricar Mango durante la planificación de la temporada.


 Debido a la relevancia de los proyectos de Mango Advanced Analytics, cada squad tiene visibilidad y presentaciones a nivel de junta directiva.
   

  

**SOBRE MANGO**
 En Mango nos inspira y une nuestra pasión por el estilo y la cultura. Estamos presentes en 118 países y nuestra presencia online se extiende a más de 80 países. Nuestro equipo está formado por personas de 112 nacionalidades, de las cuales el 80% son mujeres.
   

  

 Somos un equipo muy dinámico, motivado por las nuevas tecnologías, con pasión por lo que hacemos y ganas de asumir grandes retos que nos permitan seguir creciendo y aportando valor a través de los datos.
   

  

**TU NUEVO ROL**
 Como Senior Data Scientist formarás parte del equipo que da forma a la inteligencia, estrategia y arquitectura de datos de Mango. Trabajarás desarrollando soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial desarrolladas con modelos de datos y algoritmos de última generación. Estos productos de datos permiten casos de uso muy innovadores en el espacio del retail, como la geoanalítica, la robotización, la personalización omnicanal, la tienda conectada, la visión por ordenador, el consumidor 360º y las decisiones en tiempo real.
   

  

 En tu día a día…
   

  

* Realizarás el desarrollo de algoritmos avanzados de aprendizaje automático e inteligencia artificial para mejorar nuestros procesos y decisiones comerciales principales.
* Trabajarás con un sólido enfoque de ingeniería (por ejemplo, integración continua, automatización de pruebas, etc.) en un sólido equipo de ingenieros de datos y científicos de datos.
* Utilizarás Spark para escalar tus modelos y aprovecharás las herramientas de MLOps para desplegarlos en producción.
* Interactuarás con las partes interesadas del negocio para asegurar la alineación y la adopción adecuadas; y participarás en la entrega del proyecto de principio a fin.
* Trabajarás con un enfoque rápido e iterativo en nuevas ideas y pruebas de conceptos.
* Estarás conectado a los últimos desarrollos en Data Science y MLOps e invertirás tiempo en traer nuevas tecnologías y mejores prácticas a Mango.


**SOBRE TI**
* Al menos 4 años de experiencia como Data Scientist.
* Grado o Máster en Ciencias de Datos, Inteligencia artificial, Informática, Matemáticas, u otros campos cuantitativos.
* Al menos 4 años de experiencia desarrollando en Python, u otro lenguaje orientado a objetos.
* Experiencia desarrollando en PySpark para procesar grandes volúmenes de información de manera eficiente.
* Experiencia desarrollando modelos matemáticos y algoritmos predictivos (modelos supervisados y no supervisados, clustering, redes neuronales, etc.).
* Experiencia desarrollando soluciones de machine learning end\-to\-end, desde la fase de prototipo hasta la puesta en producción y mantenimiento.
* Experiencia trabajando con servicios Cloud (por ejemplo, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) y en entornos con computación distribuida.
* Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita, capaces de explicar conceptos técnicos a audiencias no técnicas y colaborar efectivamente con equipos multidisciplinarios.
* Se valora positivamente tener experiencia en el desarrollo e implementación de soluciones con modelos de IA generativa como GPT\-4 o similares, incluyendo técnicas como Prompt Engineering y Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Se valora positivamente tener experiencia en el uso de librerías enfocadas a Deep Learning como Tensorflow o PyTorch.
* Se valora muy positivamente el interés en buenas prácticas de programación y desarrollo de software: tests, automatizaciones, construyas pipelines en CI, etc.
* Persona comprometida, proactiva, curiosa, con ganas de innovar, y una mentalidad hands\-on.


**TUS BENEFICIOS**
* Incorporación inmediata con contrato indefinido.
* Ofrecemos horario flexible (puedes entrar de 8 a 9\.30 y salir de 17 a 18\.30\) con jornada intensiva todos los viernes (puedes entrar de 8 a 9 y salir de 14 a 15\) y la mayoría de las vigilias de festivos
* Nuestras oficinas se encuentran en Palau\- Solita i Plegamans.
* Posibilidad de teletrabajo en un 50%.
* 35% de descuento en todas nuestras líneas
* Te podrás formar a nivel técnico en plataformas como O'Reilly, entre otras, así como en idiomas, y en habilidades para tu desarrollo personal. Te acompañamos para que sigas creciendo a nivel profesional y personal!
* Política de referrals, podrás participar en la incorporación de talento a nuestros equipos, ¡y te recompensaremos por ello!
* Transporte gratuito de empresa desde Barcelona y el Vallès para llegar a nuestras oficinas centrales
* Sala de fitness y vestuarios por si te gusta hacer deporte en tu tiempo libre en las oficinas centrales.
* Workshops, meetups, comunidades de prácticas, team buildings y company meetings
* Paquete de retribución flexible con ventajas fiscales: seguro médico, formación, descuento comedor, guarderías etc
* Servicio de comedor y cocina en las instalaciones de la central. La empresa subvenciona parte del menú diario, así como los artículos de cafetería.
* Servicio médico propio en las instalaciones de la central.
* Formarás parte de una empresa líder en el sector de la moda, dinámica, en plena innovación, con gran concienciación y realizando acciones hacia la sostenibilidad
* Ambiente de trabajo cercano, inspirador y ambicioso, trabajarás con un gran equipo que va en la misma dirección para conseguir los mejores resultados

 Apply now

* Vibrant campus life with a strong sense of community \& inclusion
* Enjoy a career that makes a difference by collaborating \& learning from the best


**At UNSW, we pride ourselves on being a workplace where the best people come to do their best work.**
 The School of Biological, Earth and Environmental Sciences is a large, collaborative and multi\-disciplinary school in the Faculty of Science at the University of New South Wales with over 170 academic, research and professional staff. In 2025, the school obtained $22M in research funding, produced over 800 scientific publications and is frequently rated among the top schools across UNSW in student experience surveys. The School incorporates a broad range of disciplines, enabling comprehensive education and research in the broad fields of Earth Science, Environmental Science, Physical Geography, Climate Science, Evolutionary Biology, Ecology and Marine Science and Oceanography.
   

  

 The Research Associate will contribute to research at the interface between ecological sciences and environmental data science and assists in the development and refinement of reproducible workflows for ecosystem\-specific and fit\-for\-purpose indicators. This role is specifically required to contribute to the ARDC funded Ecosystem Indicators Workflows project and will conduct research in collaboration with a core team led by the UNSW Centre for Ecosystem Science and with collaborations in other UNSW centres, and external partners in academia, industry and other sectors.
   

  

 Within the project, the Research Associate will be responsible for the completion of work packages related to development of analytical workflows following FAIR principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reproducible), and development of software tools or packages, and will contribute to other work packages related to refinement of research vocabularies, auditing datasets, documenting platform capabilities and performance, and building a community of practice.
   

  

**THIS ROLE IS LOCATED IN SYDNEY, AUSTRALIA.**
**About The Role**
* Level A ($113k \- $121k) plus 17% Superannuation and annual leave loading
* Fixed Term – 18 months (to 31st December 2027\)
* Full\-time (35 hours per week)


**Specific Responsibilities For This Role Include**
* Contribute independently or as a team member in collaborative research with a focus to enhance the quality of research outcomes in the discipline area.
* Enable research teams to create scholarly output that is recognised by peers.
* Undertake the develop of ecosystem\-specific indicator workflows under the guidance of a research leader and contribute to development of related research activities.
* Contribute ecological and/or data science expertise to workflow design and testing.
* Contribute data science expertise to support data transformation, harmonisation, and metadata development.
* Collaborate with research software engineers on implementation of software tools and other solutions for reproducible research, including supporting requirement gathering and user testing activities.
* Contribute to documentation, elaboration of case studies and example applications.
* Collaborate with community and engagement team to support training activities, community events and the dissemination of research outcomes through appropriate channels and outlets.
* Undertake discipline\-appropriate research activities, e.g. surveys, literature reviews, data gathering and/or recording of results using appropriate research methods.
* Participate in and/or present at conferences and/or workshops relevant to the project as required. Assist with the supervision of research students in the research area where required.
* Align with and actively demonstrate the Code of Conduct and Values.
* Cooperate with all health and safety policies and procedures of the university and take all reasonable care to ensure that your actions or omissions do not impact on the health and safety of yourself or others.

description:
¡Hola!
   

  

 Soy Mariana, recruiter de esta posición. Viajar es una de mis mayores alegrías, y lo que lo hace aún más especial es poder vivir esas experiencias con mi familia y nuestra querida gata Rosita.
   

  

 Quizás somos la décima oferta que lees hoy, en el sofá con Netflix de fondo, o en pleno proceso de cambios… y todas te parecen iguales.
   

  

 ¡Te seré clara, en Zurich no somos perfectos, pero molamos bastante! Y si quieres saber por qué, sigue leyendo.
   

  

 Antes de nada, GRACIAS por interesarte en nuestra compañía. Sabemos que la búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades suele ser un reto, pero… ¡no te preocupes que todo llega!
   

  

**¡Vayamos al grano!** 
 Intentaré resumirte en 2 puntos
 **nuestro ADN:**
* Nos encanta el voluntariado, pero preferimos ser activistas del cambio. ¿Cómo? Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2024 hicimos más de 20\.000 horas de activismo.
* En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad, sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección).


 ¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas.
   

  

**Y te preguntarás: Mariana ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento):**
 Ha llegado el momento de dar un paso más para coger velocidad, crecer y proteger nuestra posición de líderes en nuestro negocio y para ello necesitamos disponer de un equipo de especialistas con conocimiento técnico y presencia en el mercado.
   

  

 La persona seleccionada se responsabilizará de diseñar, implantar y mantener las tarifas, así como garantizar la rentabilidad técnica de los productos.
   

  

 Tu día a día consistirá en:
   

  

* Elaboración, implantación y mantenimiento de tarifas en los segmentos de Motor y Hogar.
* Elaboración de requerimientos funcionales de dichas tarifas para su mecanización en las aplicaciones correspondientes.
* Adaptación de las tarifas actuales a las nuevas oportunidades de negocio.
* Colaboración con el área de Suscripción y Comercial para adecuar la tarifa a reglas de negocio y validaciones existentes.
* Gestionar el flujo y calidad de datos actuariales relevantes de directo para asegurar un output robusto.
* Análisis y seguimiento de la conversión y retención.
* Análisis de la competitividad de precios del mercado, para la toma de decisiones.
* Análisis evolución nuevo negocio y cartera (todos los indicadores técnicos de seguimiento del negocio).


**A estas alturas, te estarás preguntando, ¿Cómo sé si encajo?**
 No te preocupes, no te voy a pedir que salves el planeta ni que cumplas el 100% de los requisitos.
   

  

* Experiencia mínima 5 años en funciones similares en Pricing.
* Licenciatura o titulación universitaria superior en Ciencias Actuariales, Matemáticas o Estadística o Data Scientist.
* Capacidad analítica.
* Conocimiento de los indicadores de negocio asegurador.
* Usuario/a avanzado en software de modelización de tarifas (preferentemente Emblem y Radar) y bases de datos.
* Usuario/a avanzado de técnicas de machine learning.
* Usuario avanzado de programación en Python.
* Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y habilidad de relación con clientes internos.
* Autonomía en la toma de decisiones.
* Responsabilidad de procesos completos.


 Ahora mismo, o estás con la emoción de cuando un pantalón te entra perfecto o estás pensando: “esto no es para mí” (si no es para ti, no pasa nada, ya nos volveremos a encontrar en el futuro). Puedes hacer de celestina compartiendo mi contacto con quien creas que pueda encajar.
   

  

 En Zurich somos muy
 **disfrutones** 
 , nos gusta vivir la vida. Ya me contarás cómo podemos hacerte feliz, pero a mí me encanta poder conciliar mi trabajo con mi vida personal. Aquí la flexibilidad horaria y la desconexión digital son reales.
   

  

**\#PorSerDeZurich** 
 , puedes escoger los beneficios que mejor se adaptan a tus necesidades. Ya sabemos que, para gustos, los colores.
   

  

* Te ofrecemos un modelo híbrido mega flexible para trabajar cómo y dónde quieras dentro de España. Te ayudamos con un bono de oficina en casa.
* Confiamos en la filosofía de aprender haciendo para que puedas moverte a otras áreas a nivel local o internacional gracias a nuestro programa “Talento en Movimiento”. Y para que sigas con tu desarrollo y crecimiento: clases de inglés, formación y programa de mentoring personalizado.
* Queremos romperte los esquemas de la retribución flexible. Con nuestra bolsa de beneficios, podrás elegir lo que mejor se amolde a ti y a tus necesidades: seguro médico, guardería, formación, tickets restaurante... ¡y mucho más!
* Nos gusta dibujar sonrisas y en Zurich sabemos que es más fácil de lo que parece, por eso somos activistas. ¿Y por qué no dedicar un día entero a la causa que más te motive?
* Referral bonus si nos recomiendas algún talento como tú. No buscamos a nadie perfecto, pero si conoces a alguien que mola, compártele mi contacto, me encantará conocerle.
* ¡Si tienes espíritu deportivo, en Zurich vamos a por el oro! Maratones, carreras, descuentos en gimnasio y mucho más. 3,2,1… ¡calienta que salimos!
* ¿Eres más de playa o de montaña? Tendrás 25 días de vacaciones, más el día del seguro y el día de tu cumpleaños para que disfrutes de lo que más te gusta. Pero que no te engañen, desconexión de verdad. Porque sí, todos nos merecemos un descansito y disfrutar de la vida, que son dos días.
* En Zurich, pensamos en tu futuro y te ofrecemos plan de jubilación y seguro de vida.
* ¡Buscamos los mejores precios para ti! Tendrás acceso a miles de descuentos en productos aseguradores y bancarios.


 Si has llegado hasta aquí, GRACIAS por leerme. ¿Qué te ha parecido? ¿Molamos o no?
   

  

 Si has sentido mariposas en el estómago y crees que encajamos, manda señales de humo, o el CV, si no te va bien lo del humo.
   

  

 Y para ir terminando, ¿quieres saber qué opinan otras personas que forman parte de Zurich? Yo te diría que seguimos estando en lo más alto en Top Employers España como carta de presentación, pero te animo a echar un vistazo a nuestro perfil de Glassdoor para que sean ellas quiénes te lo cuenten. Sin trampa ni cartón.
   

  

 Espero conocerte muy pronto.
   

  

 Mariana Malnis

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
**We power people’s progress.**
 At Preply, we’re all about creating life\-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human\-led, tech\-enabled \- and it’s creating real impact.
   

  

 We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human\-led, AI\-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000\+ tutors teach 90\+ languages to learners in 180 countries \- and we’re only getting started. As a category\-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.
   

  

 Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.
   

  

**Meet the team!**
 At Preply, data is at the heart of every decision we make. We run hundreds of A/B tests to continually optimize our product, each with its own analytical and tracking challenges. The complexity of our subscription model, along with the unique dynamics of tutor\-learner interactions, offers an exciting opportunity for those looking to make a real impact.
   

  

 As a Staff Data Scientist , you will own the data strategy for a critical product domain (e.g., Growth, Retention, Marketplace) and act as the senior analytical authority in that space. You will partner with Directors and VPs across Product, Engineering, and Business to shape long\-term strategy, influence investment decisions, and ensure our roadmap is grounded in rigorous, scalable measurement frameworks.
   

  

 Our Data Team is dedicated to empowering top\-quality decision\-making. Do you want to know how? Visit our Tech Radar to learn about the technologies we use at Preply!
   

  

**What you’ll be doing:**
* Develop and formalize a strategic understanding of the key value drivers of your domain, including user behavior, marketplace dynamics, pricing, and long\-term unit economics \- and translate these into actionable decision frameworks used by leadership.
* Define the long\-term measurement and experimentation strategy for your domain, identifying structural growth levers and step\-change opportunities beyond incremental optimization.
* Design the experimentation programme in your domain and execute, and evaluate large\-scale experiments to test new ideas and measure their effectiveness in driving business outcomes.
* Lead deep analytical investigations into customer behavior and retention dynamics, reframing ambiguous business questions into structured analyses that drive step\-change improvements in long\-term value.
* Own impact modeling and scenario analysis for major product initiatives, enabling quarterly and annual planning decisions through robust forecasting, trade\-off analysis, and risk assessment.
* Own the definition and governance of key metrics within your domain, ensuring clarity, consistency, and alignment with company\-level objectives.
* Act as a senior thought partner to product, engineering, and data leaders, driving alignment across teams and elevating analytical standards across the organization.
* Lead cross\-domain analytical initiatives (e.g., company\-wide LTV modeling, pricing strategy, marketplace health framework).


**What you need to succeed:**
* Demonstrated track record of materially influencing product or business strategy in complex environments, with clear examples of company\-level impact.
* Expertise in experimentation and causal inference, including operating under imperfect conditions, resolving ambiguity, and guiding high\-stakes decisions where clean experiments are not always feasible.
* Strong understanding of subscription and marketplace economics, including LTV modeling, cohort dynamics, retention mechanics, pricing trade\-offs, and long\-term value optimization.
* Strong technical proficiency (e.g., SQL, Python) with the ability to review and elevate the analytical work of others, set coding standards, and design scalable analytical workflows.
* Experience mentoring and technically guiding senior data scientists, contributing to the overall growth and maturity of the data organization.
* Curiosity, problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills, as well as the ability to proactively identify and address challenges.
* Ability to influence Directors and VP\-level stakeholders, navigate conflicting incentives, and drive clarity in high\-stakes strategic discussions.
* Interest in the bigger picture, feeling excited to impact the product roadmap and strategy.


**Nice to have:**
* Background in 2\-sided marketplaces or digital businesses (B2C, B2B2C).
* Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, Heap).
* Experience applying advanced analytical methods (e.g., forecasting, causal modeling, pricing optimization) to drive structural business improvements.
* Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI).
* Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field.
* Demonstrated experience developing Senior Data Scientists and contributing to raising the analytical bar across teams.


**Why you’ll love it at Preply**
* An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
* A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning \& Development budget and time off for your self\-development;
* A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
* Access to free mental health support platforms;
* The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!)


**Our Principles**
* Care to change the world \- We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
* We do it for learners \- For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
* Keep perfecting \- To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
* Now is the time \- In a fast\-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
* Disciplined execution \- What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
* Dive deep \- We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
* Growth mindset \- We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
* Raise the bar \- We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high\-performing teams that can make a real difference.
* Challenge, disagree and commit \- We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
* One Preply \- We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed\-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

title: Senior Manager Architect - Data
description:
White Collar Factory (95009\), United Kingdom, London, London
Senior Manager Architect \- Data**Our Mission**


We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Throughout our almost 30\-year history, we’ve consistently been recognised as a great place to work; in 2026, Capital One was officially ranked 9th in the UK’s Best Workplaces™ list. **Hear from our team**about what it’s like working at Capital One UK.

**About the role**


Do you love shaping the architectural technical direction of large, complex Data transformation initiatives?


It’s an exciting time at Capital One UK \- We’re on a mission to unlock organisational pace and Data agility, through creating our next generation, cloud\-based data ecosystem, to unlock the power of data, increase financial inclusion and deliver transformative, real\-time, intelligent experiences to our customers.


Capital One’s Data team is responsible for the data ecosystem, which covers the holistic data lifecycle, from the capture of high\-quality customer data in real\-time, the structuring, storage and processing of that data for insight, to the usage of the data in event driven applications, ML and AI.


As a Senior Manager Architect in Data you will be an experienced technical leader bringing business, industry and deep technical understanding to shape the architecture direction and evolution of the data ecosystem, across Cloud\-scale Distributed Data Processing, Storage \& Curated Data Consumption. You will invest in architecture excellence across the Data team, and foster innovation to unlock value across our user community of Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Analysts \& Data Governance associates.


Come and help us shape the future of financial services in the Cloud.

**What you’ll do**

* Shape the architecture direction and evolution of the data ecosystem, across Cloud\-scale Distributed Data Processing, Storage \& Curated Data Consumption
* Influence Senior stakeholders, Internal customers \& Enterprise partners, gaining consensus on key technology decisions and architecture direction of the data ecosystem
* Own and evolve architecture artefacts including reference architectures, Architecture Decision Records, and technical standards for your domain
* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Cyber and our user community of Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Analysts and Data Governance associates, solving their challenges through Data Technology, to unlock business value
* Be a passionate advocate for the data ecosystem and data technology, driving wide awareness and usage aligned to Enterprise architecture standards and patterns
* Enable simplification across our architecture, processes and technologies, by encouraging and fostering UK standardisation, the reuse of appropriate industry SaaS solutions, and adoption of Enterprise standards, patterns, capabilities and platforms as appropriate for each use case
* Nurture and grow architecture excellence \& culture within the Data team, leading technical design reviews \& driving architecture best practice both within the team and the broader Architecture organisation
* Collaborate with your peers in UK architecture and engage in the wider Enterprise architecture group

**What you’ll bring**

* Demonstrable experience as a hands\-on Senior Manager Architect, in a large, complex data led organisation
* Deep understanding \& hands\-on leverage of Modern, Cloud scale Data Technologies, with specific expertise in Distributed Data Processing architectures (Spark, PySpark, Python, Airflow), ELT data processing underpinning Data LakeHouses and Data Products for scaled use within ML \& AI
* Expertise in Streaming Data, Event Driven Design, Data Governance \& the AWS Cloud Technology stack (e.g. Glue, ServerLess, DynamoDB)
* A track record in leading the architecture vision, design \& implementation of Enterprise scale data applications, with specific focus on Distributed Data Processing systems, Data LakeHouse, Data Products, Streaming data, ML \& AI platform capabilities
* Working knowledge of ML and Generative AI, including the leverage of Agentic AI based systems within the Architecture and Software Development lifecycle
* Excellent communication skills, effortlessly navigating across tech, architecture, product and senior stakeholders to achieve alignment
* Proficiency in software development principles, patterns, and practices including CI/CD
* Passion for growing architectural and data led thinking, with experience in embedding \& scaling this within in a large Enterprise setting
* An ability to shape the adoption of modern Data Technology and support the evolution of a Data driven culture, across a scaled, cross functional organisation
* There is no one type of architect; you are the glue that adds value where it’s needed. To achieve this you are flexible, adapting your approach to meet the needs of the team, initiative, or product. You solicit differing views, are willing to change your mind and perspective as you learn more, and are adept at building consensus to align stakeholders to a common direction
* Experience in Financial Services or Regulated sector beneficial

**Where and how you'll work**


This is a permanent position which can be based in either our London or Nottingham offices.


We embrace a hybrid approach to work. You'll spend three days a week in the office (Tuesday\-Thursday), with Monday and Friday being dedicated work\-from\-home days.


Our offices are designed to inspire and support you. At our Nottingham head office, you'll find an on\-site gym, restaurant and dedicated Learning Loft. Our London office boasts a rooftop running track and coffee bar.

**What’s in it for you**


We invest in the growth of our people alongside our business. You will have extensive opportunities to learn and develop your career, including access to up to £5,000 in funding for external qualifications.


In addition to career development, our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:

* Wealth \& Future: Competitive pension and performance\-based bonus schemes
* Holidays: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with tenure. Need more? You have the option to buy 5 additional days.
* Health: Access premium care through our private medical insurance.
* Family Support: We champion your milestones with enhanced parental leave.


A full list of our benefits is available here.

**What you should know about how we recruit**


We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. That’s why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible. And we offer benefits that attract people at all ages and stages.


We value diversity, inclusion and belonging at our core. We empower our associates to do great work by creating an inclusive culture—one that values diverse perspectives, fosters collaboration and encourages innovative ideas—and a place where associates of all backgrounds can thrive by bringing their most authentic selves to work. We call this our Culture of Belonging, and it rests at the heart of our business.


Our associate\-led Business Resource Groups were created to help support our diverse population and include over 10 groups across our offices. Because each Business Resource Group is as unique as the population it serves, they offer a range of activities, networking opportunities, special events and learning programs to associates.


Capital One is committed to diversity in the workplace.
If you require a reasonable adjustment, please contact ukrecruitment@capitalone.com All information will be kept confidential and will only be used for the purpose of applying a reasonable adjustment.


For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com


Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third\-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site.


Capital One Financial is made up of several different entities. Please note that any position posted in Canada is for Capital One Canada, any position posted in the United Kingdom is for Capital One Europe and any position posted in the Philippines is for Capital One Philippines Service Corp. (COPSSC).

 **Who We Are**  

  

At Capital One, we're building a leading information\-based technology company. Still founder\-led by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Fairbank, Capital One is on a mission to help our customers succeed by bringing ingenuity, simplicity, and humanity to banking. We measure our efforts by the success our customers enjoy and the advocacy they exhibit. We are succeeding because they are succeeding.  

  

Guided by our shared values, we thrive in an environment where collaboration and openness are valued. We believe that innovation is powered by perspective and that teamwork and respect for each other lead to superior results. We elevate each other and obsess about doing the right thing. Our associates serve with humility and a deep respect for their responsibility in helping our customers achieve their goals and realize their dreams. Together, we are on a quest to change banking for good.

title: Research Data Scientist
description:
dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, partnering with the world’s most ambitious retailers and brands to put the customer at the heart of every decision. We combine deep insight, advanced technology, and close collaboration to help our clients grow, innovate, and deliver measurable value for their customers.
   

  

 dunnhumby employs nearly 2,500 experts in offices throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas working for transformative, iconic brands such as Tesco, Coca\-Cola, Nestlé, Unilever and Metro.
   

  

 We’re looking for a talented
 **Research Data Scientist** 
 who expects more from their career. It’s a chance to extend and improve dunnhumby’s world class science capabilities. It’s an opportunity to work with a market\-leading business to explore new opportunities for us and influence global retailers and suppliers.
   

  

 Joining our team, you’ll work with world class and passionate people to apply machine learning and statistical techniques to business problems. You’ll contribute to the research and implementation of new approaches to address complex problems and perform data analysis and model validation. You’ll have the opportunity to present results to a variety of internal stakeholders and will apply these techniques and algorithms to create dunnhumby science solutions that can be delivered across our clients and engineered into science modules.
   

  

 This role will focus on insight automation and product assortment, leveraging data science to identify emerging and evolving product needs, optimise product mix, and predict the impact of potential changes. It will also involve product attribute generation and exploring applications of generative AI to support product development and insights.
   

  

**What you'll be doing:**
* Create new science\-based solutions that can be captured as science modules and applied across clients, with support from senior team members.
* Pick up new machine learning approaches, such as regularised regression, clustering or tree\-based ensembles, graph\-based approaches, natural language processing and neural network techniques and apply them on client data.
* Perform exploratory data analysis to characterise and visualise datasets
* Extend and develop programming skills, in languages such as Python and Spark, to develop efficient science code for science modules.
* Help identify new opportunities within the Data Science space for future dunnhumby solutions.
* Implement advice from colleagues to resolve challenges.
* Follow Quality Assurance processes, ways of working and meet coding standards.
* Ensure smooth running of your projects, working with senior team members for direction.
* Build strong relationships within the team and with internal stakeholders, ensuring clear and effective communication.


**Who you’ll get to work with:**
* Applied and Research Data Scientist teams
* Data Science Engineering teams
* Product and Client teams where required


**What you'll need:**
* Master’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Biology or related field.
* Experience with machine learning techniques such as regularised regression, clustering or tree\-based ensembles, and the ability to implement them through libraries.
* Experience with programming, ideally Python, and the ability to quickly pick up handling large data volumes with modern data processing tools, e.g. by using Hadoop / Spark / SQL
* Experience with or ability to quickly learn open\-source software including machine learning packages, such as Pandas and scikit\-learn, along with data visualisation technologies.
* A willingness to present your work to both technical and non\-technical audience and to contribute to the wider data science community.


**A plus if you also have:**
* PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Biology or related field.
* Experience in retail sector.


**What you can expect from us**
 We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.
   

  

 You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting\-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small\-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.
   

  

 And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.
   

  

**Our approach to Flexible Working**
 At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.
   

  

 We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.
   

  

 For further information about how we collect and use your personal information please see our Privacy Notice which can be found
 **(here)**

description:
**Why Faculty?**
 We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human\-centric AI. You can read about our real\-world impact here.
   

  

 We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle \- and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.
   

  

 Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.
   

  

 AI is an epoch\-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.
   

  

 From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs \- we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.
   

  

 Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

 As a Data Scientist at Third Bridge, you will be the engineering\-focused prototyping engine within a high\-impact data team.  You will work with Third Bridge’s rich proprietary data assets: transcripts, events, interaction data, commercial performance metrics, and content derived from tens of thousands of expert interviews. The role gives you the mandate to find new ways to extract value from that data, with the freedom to experiment and the expectation to ship.

* Design and build PoC solutions with a clear ‘ship\-or\-kill’ decision framework, defining evaluation criteria upfront so success is measurable, not just qualitative.

* Collaborate closely with the analytics peers to align on data definitions, shared datasets, and metric standards that underpin both experimental and production work.
* Work with the engineering team to define production requirements for successful PoCs, producing clean, well\-documented code and architecture notes to support seamless handoff.
* Advocate upstream for data quality and instrumentation requirements with Product and Engineering, contributing to the team’s engineering standards and practices.

* Masters degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a quantitative field such as Economics.
* Professional experience in a data science, ML engineering, or applied data role.
* Strong Python programming skills, including hands\-on experience with pandas, scikit\-learn, and at least one ML or deep learning framework.
* Working knowledge of Bedrock and other AWS managed services.
* Demonstrable experience building and deploying at least one end\-to\-end ML model or data pipeline in a professional setting, with clear evaluation criteria and documented outcomes.

* Strong version control practices (Git) and familiarity with software engineering workflows including code review and CI/CD awareness.
* The ability to communicate technical findings and trade\-offs clearly to both technical peers and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Qualifications**

* Familiarity with AWS Bedrock or other managed AI/LLM platforms (e.g. OpenAI API, Anthropic API) for building and integrating AI\-powered features is a strong plus, though AI capability should complement, not replace, a solid foundation in traditional ML.

* Familiarity with building lightweight web applications or data tools such as Streamlit, FastAPI, or Flask, enabling business stakeholders to interact directly with model outputs.

* Natural curiosity and a proactive approach to staying current with developments in both traditional ML and generative AI — and bringing relevant ideas back to the team.

 This is a

 .

 The Basics

 annual salary with a

 following a performance review at the successful 3\-month probation mark.

 of annual paid holiday, including bank holidays.

 Opportunity: To be part of a
 **unique and exciting company** 
 that prizes excellence of work. You will work closely with the CEO and become part of a dedicated and forward\-thinking team. We want you to push yourself to learn new skills and be recognised as one of the best in your field.
   

  

 ♻️ Commitment: We were

**TechZero** 
 . We are committed to challenging the status quo and are always looking for ways to make a positive impact.

 Regular co\-working days at different locations in London with the team plus full access to the Hubble co\-working network at all times to use a space near where you live.

 Potential to improve skills through paid courses and subscriptions. We encourage all our team to engage with professional communities, we actively sponsor PyData Meetups and Humble Data, and we provide additional support for anyone wishing to speak at meetups/conferences.
   

  

 ️
 **Conference Budget:** 
 £1000 per employee in year 1, rising to £2000 by year 3\. This can help cover tickets, accommodation, and travel to attend relevant conferences.
   

  

**Spill:** 
 All\-in\-one mental health support programme with on\-demand access to a variety of support. We cover 8 hours of therapy with a remote therapist for each team member every year, worth up to £520\.
   

  

**Headspace:** 
 Paid membership to Headspace to encourage good daily mental practices.
   

  

**10% Time:** 
 4 hours per week dedicated to improving skills or pursuing your own project.
   

  

**Laptop \& Peripherals:** 
 Company\-owned Apple laptop plus peripherals such as a monitor and keyboard, for making remote working both comfortable and safe.
   

  

**Team Culture:** 
 We have a fantastic small team who enjoy socials together \- everything from guided walking tours to escape rooms to Bake Off experiences.
   

  

**What To Expect From The Hiring Process**
 We aim for a transparent, efficient, and enjoyable hiring process. Here is what you can expect:

 A core component of the role is applying, modifying and designing algorithms and mathematical models to solve business problems using big data architectures (Hadoop, Spark, Cloud). In this role, your primary modelling focus will be neural network\-based forecasting, with a strong emphasis on rigorous evaluation against robust baselines, careful validation, and scalable deployment.Our Data Scientists must be able to validate, document and present the modelling process and performance, as well as communicate complex solutions in a clear, understandable way to non\-experts.
   

 Data Scientists are also responsible for promoting data science across Tesco and representing Tesco across the external Data Science community.
   

 Finally, as a Data Scientist, you will be expected to drive innovation and take ownership of aspects of the project development, support the Lead Data Scientist and Product Manager in managing relationships with business stakeholders, and mentor and supervise junior team members and interns.
   

 You will;
   

* Design and improve deep learning and related machine learning forecasting models for large\-scale retail time series.
* Build robust training and backtesting pipelines (time\-aware CV, leakage controls, stability checks).
* Apply best practices for productionisation (monitoring, retraining strategies, performance and cost considerations).
* Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and business partners to ensure models are reliable, scalable, and deliver measurable business value.
